pages.text: Matter falling onto a black hole gives up energy as it spirals in - η of its rest energy, from 6% for a hole that does not spin to a third for one spinning at the limit. Fusion manages 0.7%.

The $(item)Accretion Disk Reactor$() holds a black hole in a sphere of horizon containment, its disk turning in the confinement ring. Set the hole's mass, the feed rate and the spin. Power follows the luminosity $(thing)L = η·ṁc²$() - but the light pushes back on the gas, and past the $(thing)Eddington luminosity$(), L = 1.26×10³¹ (M/M☉) W, the disk is blown away and the reactor stops.

It burns Interstellar Dust with Molecular Cloud gas, Accretion Disk Fragments, or a whole Brown Dwarf Core, leaving $(fluid)Accretion Disk Plasma$() - and now and then a $(item)Quasar Jet Filament$() from the jets out of its poles.
